details.claim: Denisovans lived across Asia from Siberia to the Tibetan Plateau.
The Harbin cranium, identified as a Denisovan in 2025, shows unique features.
Denisovans had dark skin and eyes, and a Neanderthal-like build.
Denisovans interbred with modern humans, contributing to the genetic makeup of some populations.
